project.name: Aura Commerce Storefront
project.goal: Build an open-source headless e-commerce storefront for artisanal pottery makers with local-first cart persistence and Stripe Checkout.
project.summary: Full-stack headless storefront utilizing Next.js App Router and Prisma ORM. Currently focusing on cart state synchronization and checkout session webhooks.

stack.name: Next.js
stack.notes: App Router architecture with React Server Components

stack.name: Tailwind CSS
stack.notes: Custom artisanal color palette and typography

stack.name: Prisma
stack.notes: PostgreSQL schema migrations and typed client

stack.name: Stripe
stack.notes: Hosted checkout sessions with signed webhook verification

requirements.text: Catalog browsing must render server-side for optimal SEO and Core Web Vitals.
Cart items must persist across browser reloads without requiring user login.
Support discount coupon codes during the checkout initiation flow.
Customer order history lookup via email verification link.

decisions.decision: Use Stripe Hosted Checkout instead of custom payment element
decisions.reason: Reduces PCI compliance scope and simplifies mobile payment sheet integration.

decisions.decision: Store cart state in localStorage instead of server-side session cookies
decisions.reason: Allows completely anonymous browsing without database writes until checkout starts.

decisions.decision: Use SQLite for production catalog storage
decisions.reason: Initially considered for simplicity, but replaced by PostgreSQL for concurrent inventory transactions.

completed.text: PostgreSQL database schema for products, variants, and inventory levels.
Product detail pages with image gallery and variant selector.
Zustand cart store with localStorage synchronization.

tasks.text: Implement Stripe webhook handler for checkout.session.completed event.
Add inventory decrement transaction upon verified payment webhook.
Build order confirmation thank-you page with order summary.
Setup Resend email notifications for customer receipts.

bugs.text: Rapid double-click on 'Add to Cart' button increments quantity twice.
Cart badge badge count flashes 0 briefly during SSR hydration.
Product slug collation error on special characters.

instructions: Always preserve strict TypeScript typing; never use `any`.
Database mutations must execute inside explicit Prisma transactions.
Do not log Stripe customer credentials, payment tokens, or webhook secrets.

files.purpose: Data model definitions for Products, Variants, Orders, and Customers.
Webhook listener verifying Stripe signatures and processing payments.
Zustand client store managing local cart items and persistence.

conversations.title: Next.js App Router Cart Hydration Strategy
